$description: Closed assetRole enum wired through schema, allowlist, and example. Every role carries explicit AI-generation guidance. The source project approximates a real company (Rollups / AngelList) — company-logo, trusted-by-logo, and testimonial-author-photo roles reference REAL third-party logos and REAL people's photos and are pinned to must-reuse-exact-or-omit, never AI-regenerate/fabricate, per BUILD-GUIDE.md 2.2 and MASTER-GUIDE.md 3.5/3.23.
measuredFrom: ASSET_MANIFEST.md, ASSET_MANIFEST_PRODUCTS.md, ASSET_MANIFEST_CONTENT.md, src/components/Companies.jsx (PAIRS), grep of real JSX asset usage sites

company-logo.pinnedValueNote: This role's generationPolicy is a compliance-critical pinned value, not just a member of the closed enum — see compatibility/graph.json REAL_LOGO_NO_FABRICATION and extraction/verify_all.py's pinned-role check. A drift check must reject this value being silently changed to 'may-generate-new' even though that value is otherwise valid enum membership.
company-logo.description: Real third-party investor/company/law-firm logos shown in the trusted-by and companies-grid sections (24 distinct logos across 12 pairs: basis, wispr, loveable, thinking, superlinked, boxcar, aescape, commonsclinic, privy, coverface, silna, function, amca, monad, 11x, roboflow, vance, socket, base, succinct, enam, verse, branch, plus 5 hero trusted-row logos: replit, Notion, Kit, BASE, Lovable). A generator may select FROM this real list and omit logos it doesn't have real assets for, but must never invent a new company name/logo.

trusted-by-logo.description: Subset of company-logo used specifically in hero/trust-band rows (replit, Notion, Kit, BASE, Lovable).

testimonial-author-photo.pinnedValueNote: Real named individuals' photos (e.g. marie-founder.png = Marie Schneegans). Same pinned-value guidance as company-logo — never AI-regenerate a person's likeness.
testimonial-author-photo.description: Real headshot photos of named testimonial authors.
testimonial-author-photo.measuredFrom: ASSET_MANIFEST.md:28 (marie-founder.png), src/pages/Ruv.jsx TESTIMONIALS array image fields

product-screenshot.description: Real captured screenshots of the actual Rollups/SAFE app UI (investor experience, dashboard).

blog-cover-image.description: Per-article cover images. Real assets already exist for all 9 articles; a generator producing a NEW article not in the real 9 may generate-new only if explicitly instructed that this design-repo's blog-cover-image role permits it for net-new content — default is reuse the existing set or omit.

product-illustration.description: Generic product-tile illustrations (not real people/logos/screenshots) — safe to regenerate in-brand.

capability-modal-image.description: Generic product-UI mockup images shown in the capability click-to-expand modal.

motion-graphic-lottie.description: Real, hand-authored Lottie JSON animation files (hero decorative motion, Consolidate scroll-scrubbed hero). These encode real, licensed motion design work — not a role an LLM should attempt to synthesize a new .json for.

illustrative-diagram.description: Generic before/after or conceptual SVG diagrams (e.g. cap-table-with-ruv.svg).

decorative-illustration.description: Generic footer illustration artwork with no real-world referent.
